lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare tis kau bhau naahi ||
lines.translation: One who kills this has no fear.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare s naam samaahi ||
lines.translation: One who kills this is absorbed in the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare tis kee trisanaa bujhai ||
lines.translation: One who kills this has his desires quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare s daragah sijhai ||2||
lines.translation: One who kills this is approved in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare so dhanava(n)taa ||
lines.translation: One who kills this is wealthy and prosperous.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare so pativa(n)taa ||
lines.translation: One who kills this is honorable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare soee jatee ||
lines.translation: One who kills this is truly a celibate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਤੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare tis hovai gatee ||3||
lines.translation: One who kills this attains salvation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare tis kaa aaiaa ganee ||
lines.translation: One who kills this - his coming is auspicious.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare s nihachal dhanee ||
lines.translation: One who kills this is steady and wealthy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare so vadabhaagaa ||
lines.translation: One who kills this is very fortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare s anadin jaagaa ||4||
lines.translation: One who kills this remains awake and aware, night and day. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare s jeevan mukataa ||
lines.translation: One who kills this is Jivan Mukta, liberated while yet alive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare tis kee niramal jugataa ||
lines.translation: One who kills this lives a pure lifestyle.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare soee sugiaanee ||
lines.translation: One who kills this is spiritually wise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jo is maare s sahaj dhiaanee ||5||
lines.translation: One who kills this meditates intuitively. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin thaai na parai ||
lines.translation: Without killing this, one is not acceptable,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਜਾਪ ਤਪ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot karam jaap tap karai ||
lines.translation: Even though one may perform millions of rituals, chants and austerities.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin janam na mitai ||
lines.translation: Without killing this, one does not escape the cycle of reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin jam te nahee chhutai ||6||
lines.translation: Without killing this, one does not escape death. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin giaan na hoee ||
lines.translation: Without killing this, one does not obtain spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਧੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin jooth na dhoee ||
lines.translation: Without killing this, one's impurity is not washed off.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin sabh kichh mailaa ||
lines.translation: Without killing this, everything is filthy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਉਲਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: is maaree bin sabh kichh jaulaa ||7||
lines.translation: Without killing this, everything is a losing game. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau bhae kripaal kripaa nidh ||
lines.translation: When the Lord, the Treasure of Mercy, bestows His Mercy,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਈ ਖਲਾਸੀ ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis bhaee khalaasee hoee sagal sidh ||
lines.translation: one obtains release, and attains total perfection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur dubidhaa jaa kee hai maaree ||
lines.translation: One whose duality has been killed by the Guru,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak so braham beechaaree ||8||5||
lines.translation: says Nanak, contemplates God. ||8||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har siu jurai ta sabh ko meet ||
lines.translation: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then everyone is his friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har siu jurai ta nihachal cheet ||
lines.translation: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then his consciousness is steady.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕਾੜੑਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har siu jurai na viaapai kaaRhaa ||
lines.translation: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is not afflicted by worries.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har siu jurai ta hoi nisataaraa ||1||
lines.translation: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is emancipated. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man mere too(n) har siu jor ||
lines.translation: O my mind, unite yourself with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaj tuhaarai naahee hor ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Nothing else is of any use to you. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਜੋ ਦੁਨੀਆਦਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: vade vade jo duneeaadaar ||
lines.translation: The great and powerful people of the world

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahoo kaaj naahee gaavaar ||
lines.translation: are of no use, you fool!

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਸੁਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa daas neech kul sunahi ||
lines.translation: The Lord's slave may be born of humble origins,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tis kai sa(n)g khin mahi udharahi ||2||
lines.translation: but in his company, you shall be saved in an instant. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot majan jaa kai sun naam ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is equal to millions of cleansing baths.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot poojaa jaa kai hai dhiaan ||
lines.translation: Meditating on it is equal to millions of worship ceremonies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot pu(n)n sun har kee baanee ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Word of the Lord's Bani is equal to giving millions in alms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਫਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kot phalaa gur te bidh jaanee ||3||
lines.translation: To know the way, through the Guru, is equal to millions of rewards. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: man apune mahi phir phir chet ||
lines.translation: Within your mind, over and over again, think of Him,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: binas jaahi maaiaa ke het ||
lines.translation: and your love of Maya shall depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har abinaasee tumarai sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: The Imperishable Lord is always with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: man mere rach raam kai ra(n)g ||4||
lines.translation: O my mind, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kaam utarai sabh bhookh ||
lines.translation: Working for Him, all hunger departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਦੂਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kaam na johahi doot ||
lines.translation: Working for Him, the Messenger of Death will not be watching you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਗਮਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kaam teraa vad gamar ||
lines.translation: Working for Him, you shall obtain glorious greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਮਰੁ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai kaam hovahi too(n) amar ||5||
lines.translation: Working for Him, you shall become immortal. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਡਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ke chaakar kau nahee daan ||
lines.translation: His servant does not suffer punishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ke chaakar kau nahee baan ||
lines.translation: His servant suffers no loss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਫਤਰਿ ਪੁਛੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai daphatar puchhai na lekhaa ||
lines.translation: In His Court, His servant does not have to answer for his account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਸੇਖਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee chaakaree karahu bisekhaa ||6||
lines.translation: So serve Him with distinction. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਊਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai oon naahee kaahoo baat ||
lines.translation: He is not lacking in anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੇਕਹਿ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekahi aap anekahi bhaat ||
lines.translation: He Himself is One, although He appears in so many forms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee drisat hoi sadaa nihaal ||
lines.translation: By His Glance of Grace, you shall be happy forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: man mere kar taa kee ghaal ||7||
lines.translation: So work for Him, O my mind. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko chatur naahee ko mooRaa ||
lines.translation: No one is clever, and no one is foolish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko heen naahee ko sooraa ||
lines.translation: No one is weak, and no one is a hero.
